name: Mandeep Auto Industries Ltd.
summary: Mandeep Auto Industries Ltd. is engaged in the manufacturing and supply of precision automotive and industrial metal components, including sheet metal components, various auto parts, sprocket gears, and machined components. The company also specializes in producing customized components tailored to specific customer needs. Its products find application across diverse industries such as tractors, automobiles (including two-wheelers, three-wheelers, and commercial vehicles), material handling and earth-moving equipment, railways, defense, machine tools, and the DIY sector. Mandeep Auto Industries Ltd. operates as a key supplier to major Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) in the automotive industry, primarily serving the domestic Indian market. The company's manufacturing facilities utilize advanced technologies like automatic gear hobbing and CNC systems, and it holds ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 14001:2015 certifications for its quality and environmental management systems.
